graph.name: Sopra Banking DXP Microservices Architecture
graph.notes: Sopra Banking's DXP digital platform exposes core banking APIs through a microservices architecture hosted on Kubernetes (EC2), backed by MongoDB (EC2), RDS PostgreSQL, and ElastiCache, with secure mTLS integration to external Core Banking Systems.

nodes.name: User
nodes.notes: Mobile app user issuing requests to the banking platform.

nodes.name: ELB
nodes.notes: Elastic Load Balancer segregating administration and service traffic.

nodes.name: EC2 (API Management)
nodes.notes: EC2 instances hosting the API management layer.

nodes.name: EC2 (Kubernetes)
nodes.notes: EC2 instances hosting the Kubernetes cluster running microservices.

nodes.name: EC2 (MongoDB)
nodes.notes: EC2 instances running MongoDB document database.

nodes.name: Core Banking System
nodes.notes: On-premises or client core banking system connected via secure mTLS.

edges.notes: User sends API request from mobile app to ELB.
ELB forwards traffic to API Management EC2 instances.
API Management forwards request to Kubernetes cluster on EC2.
Kubernetes microservices query or store document data in MongoDB on EC2.
Kubernetes microservices query or store relational data in RDS PostgreSQL.
Kubernetes microservices read/write cache in ElastiCache.
Kubernetes microservices consume Core Banking System APIs over mTLS.
